north_star: A huge, machine-readable hub of all AI knowledge that also improves existing skills, integrates new parts, and tests better versions.

lanes.name: Transcript fetch (cloud Whisper/caption)
lanes.improve_note: Produces 0 — YouTube blocks the datacenter IP (caption API + yt-dlp). Kept daily as a safety-net only; do not invest here.

lanes.name: Deep analysis (Claude, night-gated)
lanes.improve_note: Highest quality but rate-limited by the small Pro budget (night-gated). Use sparingly for curation/self-improve, not bulk.

lanes.name: Channel/source suggestion
lanes.improve_note: Proposes new channels daily (1 pending). Needs the owner's one-time OAuth to auto-add to the playlist (else suggestions only).

lanes.name: Transcript fetch (Supadata free tier)
lanes.improve_note: Unattended & PC-free (AI-fallback even for no-caption videos), but ~100/month free (0 recovered so far). Best for NEW videos; needs SUPADATA_API_KEY.

lanes.name: Tool discovery (off-playlist)
lanes.improve_note: Finds tools beyond the playlist 3x/week (uses Pro token). Verify it keeps producing; consider a free-engine version to save the Pro budget.

lanes.name: Transcript backfill (residential IP)
lanes.improve_note: Works (~85% of caption-less videos recoverable) but needs a home IP + manual session; coverage 11.2%. Lever: drain every session; pace gently to dodge the escalating block.

lanes.name: Free analysis lane (bulk_analyze)
lanes.improve_note: Turns transcripts into records at 0 Claude cost (avg quality 6.51/10, 12% low-source). Lever: add OpenRouter+Groq keys; expose a public index for external systems (ease_external is the weak dim).

lanes.name: Web AI news (50 sources)
lanes.improve_note: Always-on (every 6h), 1757 items stored. Solid; could add more sources + dedupe.
